guidance: Honestly handle a common objection or hesitation an owner has about automation/marketing (cost, complexity, 'it feels impersonal'). Build trust. For done-for-you cost objections: never give numbers; the honest answer is that pricing follows a diagnosis meeting.
evidence_note: Transparent and honest; no unsupported guarantees, no done-for-you pricing.
reason: Exploration (8% budget): sampling 'Objection Handling / Audience Nurture' to keep learning what performs, not just exploiting the current leader.
post_rationale: Carousels still win saves/depth for B2B objection content, and the shelfware/past-bad-experience fear is a genuinely unclaimed objection distinct from every prior cost, impersonal, lock-in, complexity, spam, adoption, migration, and accuracy objection already shipped.

guidance: Teach ONE specific, actionable tactic they can do this week to make more money. Real steps, scripts, or settings — worth paying for.
evidence_note: Tactics must be logically airtight and actually executable as described.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Education / Informative' was the most under-served eligible category (target 15%, recent 10%).
post_rationale: Before-and-after reveal and problem-solution hooks are the formats Black Arrow sees working right now for home/service niches, so this turns footage owners already have into a free, specific organic-lead tactic.
